I have built a landing page for **AutoBiz — The Automatic Online Business Platform**.

### 🔗 Live Preview Link
👉 **[View Your Live Landing Page](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/f9f7befb-338d-4ca3-a3ec-30b94ab7ba88/c606719a77e9d139d3edb70b/)**

*(All changes are automatically committed and pushed to your connected GitHub repository.)*

---

### 🌟 What Was Built

1. **High-Converting Hero Section**:
   - Modern cosmic glassmorphism UI with gradient glow accents and real-time status beacons.
   - Compelling value proposition: *"Launch an Online Business That Runs, Sells & Scales On 100% Autopilot"*.
   - Dual Call-to-Actions for launching a 14-day free trial or taking an interactive product walkthrough.
   - Social proof bar featuring **18,400+ active automated businesses**, **$42.8M+ processed**, and a **4.9/5 star rating**.

2. **Live Autonomous Command Center (Interactive Demo)**:
   - **Real-Time Revenue & Order Ticker**: Live transaction ticker that dynamically simulates and injects real-time sales every few seconds.
   - **Autonomous Swarm Monitor**: Displays active AI agents (*Agent Ava* for lead acquisition, *Agent Nexus* for checkout, *Agent Atlas* for fulfillment, *Agent Echo* for churn prevention).
   - **Agent Terminal Stream**: Live streaming log simulating backend events, sub-second latency, and rolling bank payouts.

3. **Turnkey Business Blueprints Showcase**:
   - Interactive tabbed viewer covering 4 pre-validated autonomous models:
     - **Digital Products & AI Kits** (~92% profit margins, zero inventory)
     - **Micro-SaaS Subscriptions** (Monthly recurring revenue with automated Stripe billing)
     - **Automated Drop-Commerce** (Trending products with auto-routing to verified suppliers)
     - **Autonomous Growth Agency** (Automated client intake, deliverable generation, and retainers)
   - 1-click **"Deploy Blueprint"** action pre-fills the Launch Wizard with the chosen business model.

4. **Dynamic ROI & Profit Forecaster Calculator**:
   - Interactive range sliders for **Monthly Visitors**, **Average Order Value**, and **AI Conversion Rate**.
   - Multi-currency switcher (**USD $**, **EUR €**, **GBP £**).
   - Real-time instant projections for Gross Monthly Revenue, Net Estimated Profit (~86% margins), Annual Run Rate, and Hours Saved per week.

5. **Comparison Matrix (AutoBiz vs. Legacy Business)**:
   - Clear breakdown showing the speed, cost, and time advantages of autonomous ventures over traditional eCommerce and manual client work.

6. **Customer Case Studies & Verified Reviews**:
   - Highlighting realistic success stories with verified badges, before-and-after revenue figures, and testimonial quotes.

7. **Transparent Pricing Tier & Cycle Switcher**:
   - Monthly vs. Annual toggle with a 20% discount badge.
   - Three structured tiers: **Starter Engine**, **Growth Engine** *(Featured / Most Popular)*, and **Turnkey Empire**.

8. **Interactive FAQ Accordion**:
   - Expandable accordion addressing key objections: zero-coding setup, 24-hour direct Stripe payouts, automated traffic generation, custom domain attachment, and refund handling.

9. **Interactive Modals & Embedded Floating Widgets**:
   - **3-Step Launch Wizard Modal**: Niche selection, brand configuration, and an animated progress bar simulating real-time AI cluster synthesis followed by a confetti celebration.
   - **Interactive 2-Minute Video Tour Modal**: Simulated video player with playback toggle, scrubber, and chapter navigation.
   - **Live Sales Notification Toast**: Real-time pop-ups on the bottom left simulating recent customer orders.
   - **24/7 AI Advisor Chat Widget**: Floating conversational assistant on the bottom right with quick question chips and smart automated answers.
